text:
tay: Pushed a small docs PR to fix param ordering and an example mismatch on /v1/generate. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310

olga: Which mismatch?

tay: The OpenAPI example had `max_new_tokens` before `input` in the JSON example which confused the Go SDK example generator (claimed invalid payload). Also curl and JS examples had slightly different shapes for `generate.options`.

chris: Ok can we standardize examples to show `input` first, then `model`, then `options` so it's consistent across languages?

tay: Yep. PR updates the examples and the OpenAPI sample object. I also added an explicit example for `generate.options` showing `max_new_tokens` as an integer and `temperature` as a float, plus a note that `max_new_tokens` is applied post-filtering.

olga: Please add a tiny migration note: "If you relied on example ordering for codegen, run an updated codegen to regenerate clients."

chris: Looks fine. docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1310 

tay: Merging once CI passes. :shipit:
__notes: Slack thread: quick docs PR coordination to fix example param ordering and generate.options shape across samples
